# Noryvex

> Never miss another dental patient call.

Noryvex is a done-for-you AI receptionist agency for dental clinics. We build and manage custom AI voice receptionists that answer calls, capture patient details, handle clinic FAQs, collect appointment requests, and hand them off to your existing calendar or CRM.

## Key Information
- **Official Website**: https://trynoryvex.com
- **Founder**: Muhammad Razi (https://www.linkedin.com/in/mrazi-dev/)
- **Core Focus**: Done-for-you AI voice receptionists for dental clinics (cosmetic, general, orthodontist, pediatric, emergency).
- **Tech Stack**: Latency-optimized speech synthesis (&lt;800ms) utilizing Twilio, Vapi, ElevenLabs, and custom integration pipelines.

## Capabilities
- **Inbound AI Receptionist**: Answering patient calls 24/7 (during lunch breaks, peak times, and after-hours).
- **Appointment Requests**: Gathering patient preferred date, time, contact info, and reason for visit.
- **Clinic FAQs Answering**: Responding to opening hours, location details, accepted insurances, pricing guidance, and treatment questions.
- **Summaries & recordings**: Logs of calls, recordings, and text summaries pushed directly to your team's email or dashboard.
- **US Phone Numbers**: We provide a dedicated phone number in any US state for your clinic's line.
- **Practice Management Integration**: Direct or dashboard/email handoffs to existing clinic tools.
- **HIPAA Compliance**: Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) signed with clinics; TLS 1.3/AES-256 data security protocols.

## Navigation & Entry Points
- **Home**: Overview of dental receptionist solutions, process flow, and custom pricing comparison.
- **Solutions**: Detailed review of the 6 core capability panels, safety disclaimers, and integration paths.
- **Live Demo**: Browser-simulated live call with "Chloe" configured for Bright Dental clinic.
- **About**: Description of founder Muhammad Razi's 4-step quality assurance review workflow.
- **Contact**: Clinic intake form to get a free custom demo.

## FAQ
- **Is Noryvex a SaaS product?**: No, Noryvex is a full-service managed agency. We build, train, configure, test, and manage the receptionist for you end-to-end.
- **How much does it cost?**: We build a free custom demo first. You only pay when you decide to launch the full system.
- **How long does it take?**: We can design, configure, and share your clinic's voice prototype in under 48 hours.
